title: Service Module Profile v1
summary: A backend service or worker module that exposes commands, configuration, APIs, health, deployment, and operational handoff points.

compatibility.versioning: Breaking changes require a new module descriptor id or declared compatibility note.

integration_points.name: commands
integration_points.description: Build, run, test, validate, package, and migration commands.

integration_points.name: operations
integration_points.description: Deployment status, health checks, logs, metrics, and rollback signals.

checks: Descriptor declares selected contracts and local profiles.
Commands are runnable or explicitly marked unavailable in the target environment.
Configuration and secret references are declared without literal secret values.
API surface has request, response, auth, error, and limit semantics.
Health and observability handoff points are discoverable.

agent_guidance: Prefer this profile for backend services, workers, and deployable service packages.
Keep framework-specific details in local schemas or profiles.
Report command, API, configuration, and health surfaces when finishing implementation.
